rationale.conceptual: The method involves the Eshelby tensor, Mori-Tanaka homogenization, multi-inclusion method, and orientation averaging. These are established but non-trivial micromechanics concepts that require careful implementation of fourth-order tensor operations and numerical integration; it is more than a simple library call but not a novel algorithm.
rationale.execution: The workflow consists of 2-3 sequential coding steps (baseline, verification, final computation) using only numpy/scipy. No complex environment, data fetching, or multi-stage orchestration; straightforward I/O to produce a single CSV.
